name: Stainless Steel Lemon Squeezer
description:
Made from high-quality stainless steel with a polished finish

Diameter: 2.5 inches, suitable for small and large fruits

Dimensions: 8.75 in (L) × 1.8 in (H)

Weight: 15 ounces

Interior grooves guide juice directly to the strainer

Recommended for hand washing

Color: As shown in pictures

Description:
Effortlessly extract juice from citrus fruits with this durable stainless steel juicer. Designed with interior grooves, it efficiently guides juice into the strainer while keeping seeds and pulp separate. Compact yet versatile, it fits both small and large fruits, making it perfect for fresh juices at home. Polished finish adds durability and a sleek look to your kitchen tools.
